highlights.title: Spreadsheets open in the file viewer
highlights.line: A spreadsheet (.xlsx, .csv or .tsv) now opens as a read-only grid, with each sheet as a tab. It shows the values saved in the file.

highlights.title: The KOSMOS orb on the big waits
highlights.line: Opening, updating and Kosmos+ sign-in now wait under the KOSMOS orb, and making an agent ends with the orb's dots turning into a check.

highlights.title: Always Allow for downloads from your computers
highlights.line: On the Mac, a download from another of your computers can now be set to Always Allow, kept while that computer is on your Kosmos+ account.

highlights.title: Kosmos says when others can change its folder
highlights.line: On Windows, Kosmos now says so when it runs from a folder other accounts on the PC can change, and what to do about it.

highlights.title: Gemini agents stop updating gemini
highlights.line: A new Gemini agent turns off gemini's updates unless you chose to keep them. On your default account that includes gemini you run yourself.
